# Recovered Meta XR Audio SDK v85 API surface
#
# Meta ships no headers for this API. These 251 signatures were recovered from the
# MSVC-mangled C++ exports in MetaXRAudioUnity.dll via undname.exe. They are the type
# vocabulary behind the 103 portable mxra_* C entry points bound in MetaXRAudioABI.hpp;
# the two are parallel implementations, not shims, so treat these as documentation of
# the engine's shapes rather than as callable symbols (they are mangled differently on
# Android and are not part of the stable ABI).
#
